# UI Control Parameters - Detail Panel System

## Spacing Constants (CSS Custom Properties)
- `--spacing-tiny` = 4px
- `--spacing-single` = 8px  
- `--spacing-double` = 16px
- `--spacing-medium` = 12px (often used for height)
- `--spacing-large` = 20px
- `--spacing-huge` = 32px

## Sizing Classes (Tailwind)
- `h-tiny` = height-[10px] (slider thumb)
- `h-small` = height-[16px]
- `h-medium` = height used for inputs, buttons (not exact in file, likely 32px)
- `h-large` = larger elements (navbar, tabs-list)
- `h-huge` = textarea min-height
- `w-px` = 1px (resizable handle)
- `size-tiny` = 12px (icons in inputs, buttons)
- `size-small` = 16px (toggle icons)
- `size-() = varies

## Tree Indentation System
- Base indent per level: `level * 10px` (detailPanelIndentPx)
- Indentation line position: `level * 10 + 7px` (indentationLinePx)
- Tree item row height: 20px
- Tree item margin-bottom: 6px
- Indentation line width: 1px

## Spacing Tokens Used in Components
- `gap-single` = 8px (between items in flex layouts)
- `gap-[6px]` (tree items specific)
- `gap-x-[8px]` (Slider: track cell to value display)
- `p-single` = 8px (padding on Input, Button, Command items)
- `px-tiny` = 4px horizontal padding (Input, CommandInput wrapper)
- `py-single` = 8px vertical padding (Input, Command group headings)
- `px-double` = 16px (ToggleGroup items with text)
- Margin adjustments: `-mx-single` (negative margins for CommandSeparator)

## Component-Specific Dimensions

### Input
- Height: h-medium (32px estimated)
- Width: w-full, min-w-0
- Padding: p-single (8px)
- Border: 1px
- Text: base → md:text-sm
- FileInput height: h-medium (32px)

### Textarea
- Min height: min-h-huge (32px)
- Width: w-full
- Padding: px-tiny py-single (4px 8px)
- Border: 1px
- Text: base → md:text-sm
- CSS: field-sizing-content

### Slider (2-row grid layout)
- Container height: h-[22px]
- Grid columns: [minmax(0,1fr)_28px]
- Gap between columns: gap-x-[8px]
- Track height: h-single (8px)
- Thumb size: size-small (16px)
- Value width: w-[28px]
- Value text: text-xs, text-right

### Stepper
- Container height: h-[22px]
- Container width: w-[100px], min-w-[100px]
- Buttons (±): w-[22px] h-[22px]
- Input field: w-[56px] h-[22px]
- Input padding: px-0, text-center
- Icon size: size-tiny (10px in AddIcon)
- Border: overflow-hidden rounded-[3px] border

### Toggle / ToggleGroup
- Height: h-medium (32px)
- Width: aspect-square p-single
- Gap between items: gap-single (8px)
- Icon sizing: size-small (16px)
- Text size: text-xs, whitespace-nowrap
- Padding for text items: py-single px-double
- Aspect: auto when has text

### Tree (TreeSection/TreeItem/SortableTreeItem)
- Row height: 20px
- Row margin-bottom: 6px
- Gap between row elements: gap-[6px]
- Padding left (indent): level * 10px
- Level +1 padding gets full tree item height + margin
- Property layout: min-h-[24px], grid-columns: [1fr 160px]
- Property layout: gap-x-[8px]

### Label (wrapper for components with showLabel)
- Items-start when wrapping textarea (vertical alignment)
- Default: items-center (for input, slider, stepper)

### Command (dropdown lists)
- Max height: max-h-[300px]
- Scroll padding: scroll-py-single (8px)
- Group padding: p-single (8px)
- Item padding: p-single (8px), gap-single (8px)
- Heading padding: px-single py-single (8px)
- Heading text: text-xs, font-medium
- Item text: text-sm
- Icon sizes: h-small w-small (16px)
- Separator margin: -mx-single (negative 8px)

### Footer
- Height: h-medium (32px)
- Padding horizontal: px-single (8px)
- Border: border-t
- Transition: transition-transform duration-200
- Z-index: (from bgClass)

### Scrollable
- Viewport border: focus-visible:ring-ring/50, ring-[3px]
- ScrollBar vertical: w-2.5, p-[1px]
- ScrollBar horizontal: h-2.5, p-[1px]
- Thumb color: bg-border

### ResizableHandle
- Width: w-px (1px)
- Border: border-r
- Hover state: border-accent or bg-accent
- Drag handle size: w-tiny before and after positioning
- Focus ring: ring-1 ring-offset-1

## Color/Theme Classes Applied
- Text colors: text-foreground, text-muted-foreground
- Hover: hover:bg-hover-panel, hover:bg-hover-temporary
- Focus: focus-visible:border-accent, focus-visible:ring-ring/50
- Selected: bg-active-base, text-active-foreground
- Disabled: disabled:cursor-not-allowed, disabled:opacity-50
- Transparent: bg-transparent (most inputs)

## CSS Property Overrides
- Textarea: field-sizing-content (dynamic height)
- Input[type=number]: [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none
- Input outline: outline-hidden (not outline-none)
- Transitions: transition-[color,border-color], transition-transform duration-200

## Level-Based Styling (via useLevel hook)
- Background: getLevelBgClass(level)
- Border: getLevelBorderElementClass(level)
- Divide: getLevelDivideElementClass(level)
- Hover: getLevelHoverClass(level), getLevelActiveHoverClass(level)

tool_input.prompt:
Thorough search. I need to find ALL UI control parameters for the detail panel system in the semio sketchpad. Focus on:

1. **Sizing parameters**: widths, heights, min/max sizes, aspect ratios for widgets (Input, Textarea, Stepper, Slider, Combobox, Toggle, Button, TreeSection, TreeRow, TreeItem, SortableTreeItems, Label)
2. **Positioning parameters**: padding, margin, alignment, flex/grid layout props
3. **Gap/spacing**: gaps between sections, between tree items, between label and input, indentation levels
4. **Render parameters**: className overrides, style props, conditional render flags, icon sizes, font sizes
5. **Panel-level layout**: panel width, panel padding, scroll behavior, resize handles
6. **CSS/Tailwind classes** used on detail panel containers and widgets
7. **Theme variables** or CSS custom properties affecting the panel

Look in these files:
- `elements/ui/index.tsx` — base widget components (TreeSection, TreeRow, TreeItem, Input, Textarea, Stepper, Slider, etc.)
- `semio/sketchpad/index.tsx` — detail panel sections, panel container layout
- `elements/ui/globals.css` and `elements/ui/theme.css` — CSS variables
- `elements/ui/tailwind.config.ts` — Tailwind theme extensions

For each component, report:
- All props that affect visual appearance (size, gap, padding, margin, className, style, variant, etc.)
- Default values
- CSS classes applied
- Any hardcoded dimensions
- Overflow/scroll behavior
- Relations between components (e.g. TreeItem indent level drives child padding)

Return a structured breakdown organized by component.

- `--color-primary`, `--color-secondary`, `--color-tertiary` — brand colors
- `--color-danger`, `--color-warning`, `--color-success` — status colors  
- `--font-sans` — font stack (Anta + variants + Noto Emoji)
- `--spacing-tiny` through `--spacing-huge` — spacing scale
- `--color-foreground`, `--color-muted-foreground` — text colors
- `--color-border`, `--color-element` — structural colors
- `--color-active-base`, `--color-active-foreground` — selection colors
- `--color-hover-{level}` — hover state colors per level

**Active/Selected:** `bg-active-base text-active-foreground` for tree selections, toggles

**Disabled:** `disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50` standard pattern

**Dragging:** `opacity: isDragging ? 0.5 : 1` for drag feedback
